provisions.title: Implementation
provisions.body:
The document has been created and approved by the General Assembly of 09.11.2024.
The document and its rules have been implemented since the 2025 season.

provisions.title: Definition and Rules
provisions.body:
A Belt flag is an element hung on a belt designed to show your belt number in the list.
A Belt flag must be made of fabric or leather.
A Belt flag must conform with the “Textiles and Leather’ document.

As a competitor, it is required to wear a Belt flag with your belt number during buhurt fights.t is not required for duel and outrance fights.

A competitor may have a second Belt flag that is decorative. No more than two Belt flags may be worn by a competitor.

provisions.title: General Requirements
provisions.body:
Belts flags consist of a base and a number.

Base must:
● have a shape that can be square, rectangular or triangular,
● have atrim to be worn with a belt,
● be made of one main color.

Some decoration can be added on the edges of the base.
Such decoration must not interfere with the readability of the Belt flag.

Numbers must:
● have individual figures from 0 to 9,
● be from 01 to 99,
● be written in Arabic numerals,
● be 13 cm tall as a minimum.

Numbers can be of any color, contrasting with the base main color.
All Belt flags must respect the following dimensions:

● Length: from 26 cm to 36 cm.
● Width: from 14 cm to 18 cm.

Symbols and decorations used for belt flags must be based on historical sources. Any clearly modern symbol or decoration is denied.

Examples: Warhammer logos, movies or TV show imagery, modern slogans, etc...
Exception: It is allowed to wear a belt flag with the global medical imagery stating you are hearing impaired or deaf:

January - 2026 (V. 26.1) Formatting redone for consistency and readability. Except points listed below, no content changes.

- Split of “1. Definition and general requirements” in “2. Definition and Rules” and “3. General Requirements”. This split doesn’t have an impact on the content of the rules.

- “Examples of Approved Reproductions” is now “4.” instead of “1.2”

Add:

- In 3. General Requirements: “Exception: it is allowed to wear a belt flag with the global medical imagery stating you are hearing impaired or deaf’ + picture

- In 4. Examples of Approved Reproductions: New picture to illustrate a belt flag for hearing-impaired people

Replace:

- In “2. Definition and rules”: “As a competitor, you must have a belt flag with your number [...]” by “As a competitor, it is required to wear a belt flag with your belt number [...]”
